## English

Default the UI language to auto.

- `language` now defaults to `auto`: the UI follows the system language, read from
  the OS first and only then from the POSIX locale variables.
- A detected locale is matched against the registered languages by full tag, then
  by primary subtag, so a `lang/ja.toml` shipped later is picked up on a Japanese
  machine by itself.
- Startup logs which language auto chose.

## 中文

界面语言默认改为 auto。

- `language` 默认值改为 `auto`：界面跟随系统语言，优先读操作系统、其次才读 POSIX locale 变量。
- 检测到的区域按完整语言标签匹配，再按主语言子标签回退；因此以后新增 `lang/ja.toml`，日文机器会自动识别。
- 启动日志会记录 auto 最终选择了哪种语言。
